0022600204.text: The Hornets (3-6, 9th in the East) come into this game on a five-game losing streak, with a 2-3 home record, while the Cavaliers (4-4, 6th in the East) have lost their last two. Charlotte is missing Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps), and Brandon Miller is day-to-day with groin soreness. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and Cleveland won the last meeting 118-113 in Charlotte on February 20, 2026, part of a 2025-26 series in which the Hornets lost 1-3.
